name: The Gravity Override hook flips onto a moving solid's face (internal/sim hook.go): on de_rackmount, with the command clock at its start (go/js: tick base 0, so the sled's phase is known; e2e's clock is the player's and hook-mover covers that), alice stands on the north lane floor 5 m west of the north drive sled, 2.5 s into its 6 s cycle (sliding out of the side panel along z). She jumps and fires +hook at its west face: it latches on the sled, the anchor riding with it, pulls her up to the face, and touching it (it slides within its own plane) flips her gravity onto it (+x): she stands on the sled's side, the hook let go
